text:
sam_cs: Heads-up  We had an onboarding throughput regression that delayed index creation for ~21 trial tenants (created 2026-07-14 -> 2026-07-16). Drafting customer note + compensation plan. Need AE triage for renewal-risk accounts.

anya: Can you share the internal list? Ill start flagging high-touch.

sam_cs: Sheet here: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted_jul_onboard. Top 6 high-touch called out: VertoHealth, AtlasDocs, CrispAI, Meridian, ScribeLab, HelixMaps. Most reprovisioned after replay; a few required manual reindex.

leo_ops: Infra summary: a temporary queue amplification during a regional scale test caused provisioning webhooks to pile up and exposed a timeout in the index writer. We rolled a targeted fix and replayed the backlog. Deploy: hotfix/2026-07-17-provision-queue-fix by @leo_ops at 2026-07-17T02:10Z.

monitor-bot: deploybot: hotfix/2026-07-17-provision-queue-fix deployed at 2026-07-17T02:10Z :white_check_mark:

sam_cs: Need a 2-sentence, non-technical RCA for customers + compensation recommendation. Also want to run a hands-on enablement session for the high-touch set to reduce churn risk.

leo_ops: RCA draft: "A temporary processing backlog briefly delayed setup for a small number of trial accounts. Our team fixed the issue, replayed the affected setups, and verified that impacted tenants are now available. We apologize for the disruption and have added monitoring to detect similar issues earlier."

anya: Good. For comp I propose: 10-day trial extension for all impacted trials + a one-time 25% service credit for trials that experienced >4 hours delay. For the six high-touch, offer a technical 1:1 (45m) plus a tailored enablement pack.

ae_lucas: From renewal POV flag VertoHealth, AtlasDocs, and Meridian as at-risk; I'll reach out and offer the 1:1 and a joint CS+AE call. If they look shaky, we can escalate to an exec review.

billing: We can apply a 25% one-time credit where qualifying. Send the impacted CSV with per-tenant delay durations and we'll queue credits.

sam_cs: Action items: anya  mark high-touch in sheet and drop sanitized CSV to billing; leo_ops  post final replay completion timestamp and monitoring dashboard link; ae_lucas  AE outreach for the three at-risk accounts; sam_cs  draft customer email and office-hours invite.

leo_ops: Replay completed at 2026-07-17T04:20Z. Reindexing verified for all tenants. Monitoring: added provisioning-queue-depth alert + index-writer-timeout metric to SLO dashboard. Link: https://redwood.internal/monitoring/provisioning-slo (internal).

anya: CSV uploaded to billing bucket. Ive also added a column with delay-hours so billing can compute eligibility.

billing: Got it. Will process credits and confirm when applied (ETA ~3h).

sam_cs: Draft outbound email below  please review: "We're sorry  a brief provisioning backlog delayed setup for a small number of trial accounts. We've fixed the issue, replayed setups, and verified availability. To make this right we've extended affected trials by 10 days and will apply a one-time 25% service credit to qualifying trials. If you'd like deeper help, we're offering a 45-minute technical 1:1 for our high-touch customers; reply to request it or join our office hours (RSVP: https://redwood.internal/events/oh-2026-07-20). We'll follow up with a short feedback form so we can learn from your experience"

ae_lucas: Looks good. Add a short apology line that acknowledges any impact on initial testing and a sentence offering to escalate to an exec if they indicate renewal concerns.

sam_cs: Updated. Sending after billing confirms credits. Closing loop here once outbound sent. Thanks team.
